_comment: Tool-facing hardware/address declaration for the Atari Centipede PCB (MOS 6502). Set: centiped3.
Read from MAME atari/centiped.cpp: centiped_base_map@695, centiped_map@718, generate_interrupt@434,
irq_ack_w@487, LS259 wiring@1784-1816, INPUT_PORTS(centiped)@1047, gfx layouts@1722-1737, machine
Numbers are decimal (JSON has no 0x); '_hex'/'_note' fields are annotations the loader ignores.
NOT YET MEASURED: this is the board-layer draft. There is no 6502 Machine/ROM golden yet, and the
centiped3 dump is missing the sync/decode PROM (136001-213.p4, NOT a colour PROM) so MAME cannot run.
controlByte, input idle probes, reset registers, and landmarks come with the state-diff/pixel wiring.
_cpu_note: MOS 6502 @ 12.096MHz/8 = 1.512MHz; slows to 0.756MHz while accessing playfield RAM 0x0400-0x07BF (bus contention). centiped.cpp:1778.

screen._note: set_size(32*8,32*8)=256x256; set_visarea(0,255,0,239)=256x240 visible, top row = native row 0. ROT270 (90 CCW) applied downstream, NOT in video.js. centiped.cpp:1799-1801,2378.

_refresh_note: set_refresh_hz(60) directly (no set_raw pixel clock), so the frame is exactly 1/60s. centiped.cpp:1798.
_cycles_note: NOMINAL 1512000/60 = 25200. ⚠ FLAG: the 6502 slows to 0.756MHz during playfield-RAM access (bus contention, centiped.cpp:1778) so the REAL per-frame instruction count is lower and data-dependent. MAME's m6502 does not model the stall, so it executes 25200; using the nominal, pending a MAME cycle capture. Do NOT guess a contended value.
_rw_differ_note: 0x2000 READ = program ROM, WRITE = watchdog reset_w. Modelled as two devices. centiped.cpp:713-714.

_ls259_note: LS259 outlatch bits (write_d7, centiped.cpp:1784-1816): q0 coin_counter_left, q1 coin_counter_center, q2 coin_counter_right, q3 led0(inv), q4 led1(inv), q7 flip_screen. q5,q6 unused.
_inputs_note: MIXED polarity. IN0 bits0-3=trackball-X counter, bit4=Cabinet DIP(0=upright), bit5=Service(ACTIVE-LOW, idle set), bit6=VBLANK(ACTIVE-HIGH, Machine-driven), bit7=trackball-X sign. IN1 all ACTIVE-LOW (idle 0xFF). IN2 bits0-3=trackball-Y, bit7=sign. Trackball axes are analog deltas (io.applyTrackball), not a joystick bitfield. Idle values below are DIPSETTING defaults, pending a MAME probe.

DSW1._bits: b1-0 Language(EN), b3-2 Lives(3=0x04), b5-4 Bonus(12k=0x10), b6 Difficulty(easy=0x40), b7 CreditMin(1). default 0x54. centiped.cpp:1082-1103.

DSW2._bits: b1-0 Coinage(1C/1C=0x02), b3-2 RightCoin, b4 LeftCoin, b7-5 BonusCoins. default 0x02. centiped.cpp:1105-1125.

IN1._bits: ACTIVE-LOW: b0 START1, b1 START2, b2 BUTTON1(fire), b3 BUTTON1-cocktail, b4 TILT, b5 COIN1, b6 COIN2, b7 SERVICE1. idle 0xFF. centiped.cpp:1057-1065.

IN3._bits: ACTIVE-LOW cocktail P2 8-way joystick; unused on the real upright board. idle 0xFF. centiped.cpp:1072-1080.

manifestInputs._trackball_note: trackball X/Y are analog deltas fed via io.applyTrackball(axis, delta), not IN bits.

_controlByte_note: TODO: ROM[0x2000] first opcode after reset, MEASURED once games/centiped/rom is present. Distinguishes a real ROM read from an unmapped throw.

interrupt._vectors_hex: 6502 vectors fold under global_mask(0x3fff): NMI 0x3FFA/B, RESET 0x3FFC/D, IRQ/BRK 0x3FFE/F.
interrupt._note: Level-triggered IRQ on the '32v' scanline timer (centiped.cpp:1794, generate_interrupt@434): TIMER configure_scanline(..., 0, 16) fires at scanlines 0,16,32,...; when (scanline & 16), IRQ = ((scanline-1)&32) ? ASSERT : CLEAR. Net: the IRQ line toggles at 16-scanline boundaries (a few IRQs/frame). The ROM ACKs by writing 0x1800 (irq_ack_w). The Machine drives assert/clear via io.setIrq()/io.ackIrq(), gated by the 6502 I flag. Separately, IN0 bit6 is a CPU-pollable VBLANK bit (active-high) -- the likely §4 frame-sync yield point. MACHINE_RESET clears the IRQ line. centiped.cpp:469-490.

_scanline_note: VTOTAL = 256 lines (set_size height). cyclesPerScanline = 25200/256 = 98.4375 (non-integer; the Machine accumulates fractionally). Render raster and the 32V IRQ schedule both key off this.

reset6502._note: 14-bit global_mask folds the 6502 vectors to 0x3FFA/C/E (top of program ROM). PC loads from resetVector; the I (interrupt-disable) flag is set at reset and MACHINE_RESET clears the IRQ line. Register reset state (A/X/Y/SP/P exact values) is owned by core/cpu/6502.js -- do not duplicate here.
